reply: strain increases with strain, and that slope falls as T rises. At fixed strain the stress grows roughly like T^1.2 to T^2 depending on the strain, so the strain and temperature dependences are coupled. Simple power laws, Arrhenius-type factors, and Voce-type saturation did not fit (NMSE 0.04–0.07).
